title: Hydragen layer manifest metadata (draft)
description: Initial metadata requirements for parsed YAML/YML, TOML, JSON, or JSONC layer manifest content at the root of a layer's repository. Name is required; author and description are optional. This schema validates contents, not filename or location, and does not yet validate dependency references or other layer behaviour.

nonBlankString.$comment: The optional x-hydragen-nonblank-pattern-sha256 annotation approves friendly non-blank diagnostics only. It is the lowercase SHA-256 of the decoded pattern string encoded as UTF-8. Missing or mismatched approval leaves validation unchanged and uses generic pattern diagnostics. Do not automatically update this token when changing the pattern; update it only after reviewing that the rule still means Unicode non-blank.
nonBlankString.description: A string containing at least one character outside Unicode White_Space. Accepted strings are not trimmed or otherwise normalized.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL or relative path used by an editor or validator.

name.description: The layer's name. Naming syntax and uniqueness rules remain undecided.

author.description: Optional person or organisation credited with authoring the layer. When supplied, this must be a non-blank string. This is descriptive metadata, not a verified identity.

description.description: Optional short explanation of what the layer provides or is used for. When supplied, this must be a non-blank string.
